text: Scarborough Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Scarborough Community Council passed By-laws 1207-2025 to 1243-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Scarborough Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 1244-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
